news.title: Prismfall 1.0 is live
news.body: One hull. Endless light. Dash, level up and seal the rift in Spectra Games' neon survival shooter.

games.title: Prismfall
games.tagline: One hull. Endless light. Survive the rift.
games.description: A neon arena survival shooter. Your prism cannon auto-fires at the nearest hostile while you move, dash and harvest light shards to level up. Survive escalating swarms, then break the Prism Wraith that breaches the rift every seventy seconds.
features: Auto-firing prism cannon with 12 stackable augmentations
Four enemy types and a boss that breaches every 70 seconds
Dash with invulnerability and a risk/reward pickup loop
Mouse-free controls, keyboard and touch support
WebAudio soundtrack-free synth effects — no asset files

achievements.name: Resonant
achievements.desc: Reach level 10 in a single run.

notes: Four enemy types, boss encounters and twelve upgrades
Keyboard and touch controls with full HUD
